title: Tesla investors really need to see progress on Robotaxi, robotics
title_zh: 特斯拉投资者确实需要看到 Robotaxi 和机器人技术的进展
summary: Tesla (TSLA) reported first quarter results on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $0.41 (compared to analyst estimates of $0.34), and revenue came in at $22.39 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $22.19 billion).
summary_zh: 特斯拉（TSLA）周三收盘后公布了第一季度业绩。调整后每股收益 (EPS) 为 0.41 美元（分析师预期为 0.34 美元），收入为 223.9 亿美元（分析师预期为 221.9 亿美元）。
